systems.country_label: school-based National ID registration campaign; mobile registration campaign
systems.owner: Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports, and Immigration
systems.tiers: launched 4 August 2026 at Juba Day Secondary School for Primary Eight and Senior Four candidates; more schools across the country planned

note: Concerns a mobile campaign issuing nationality and national identity documents in schools; nothing on the registration of births or deaths.
